jobDescription: Our company provides managed cloud hosting for around 400 small software firms. The IT Service Operations Coordinator runs the daily incident queue review, coordinates change requests through the weekly change advisory board, keeps the service catalogue and knowledge base current and produces the monthly service-level report for the account managers. The service desk follows ITIL practice, so the role requires the ITIL 4 Foundation certification; day-to-day work happens in Jira Service Management. The coordinator reports to the head of service operations and works alongside a team of eight service desk analysts across two shifts.
requirements: Runs the daily incident queue review and escalates tickets at risk of breaching response targets.
Coordinates change requests through the weekly change advisory board.
Maintains the service catalogue and knowledge-base articles.
Produces the monthly service-level report for account managers.

evidence.text: Service Desk Analyst, Marrowby Hosting (October 2022 to July 2026): chaired the 9 a.m. incident queue review in Jira Service Management and escalated tickets approaching their response target to the duty engineer.
Collected change requests from the platform engineers each week, checked that rollback steps and test evidence were attached, and prepared the agenda for the change advisory board.
Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation, issued by PeopleCert in May 2023.
Rewrote 60 knowledge-base articles on DNS changes, SSL renewal and backup restores when the support portal moved to a new template, and updated the matching service catalogue entries.

IT Support Technician, Delling School Trust (August 2020 to September 2022): set up laptops and accounts for teaching staff across three schools and handled first-line password, printer and projector tickets through the trust's helpdesk tool.

Work sample: an anonymised change advisory board pack for one week, with seven change requests, each showing the requester, risk rating, rollback plan, link to test evidence and the board's approve or defer decision.

Recruiter verification: the ITIL 4 Foundation certificate was checked on PeopleCert's online certificate verification service using the candidate number the candidate supplied; the record shows a pass in May 2023.

Reference check summary: the former service desk manager at Marrowby Hosting confirmed in writing that the candidate chaired the daily queue review and prepared the change advisory board agenda from 2023 onwards.

propositions.text: The candidate holds the ITIL 4 Foundation certification, awarded in May 2023 and checked on the issuer's verification service.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the certificate and the recruiter verification records a check on PeopleCert's service.

propositions.text: The candidate chaired the daily incident queue review and escalated tickets approaching their response target.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the queue review and the former manager confirmed it in writing.

propositions.text: The candidate prepared the change advisory board agenda and checked change requests for rollback steps and test evidence.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the preparation work, the work sample shows a weekly board pack and the reference confirms the agenda work.

gold.expectedGap: Producing a monthly service-level report for account managers is not documented; the sources show escalation of tickets against response targets only.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified ITIL 4 Foundation certificate and the documented queue, change and knowledge-base work; do not extend ticket escalation into ownership of service-level reporting.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has compiled service-level reports, which measures they covered and who received them.
